name: kit
description: Sundar Nambuvel's Claude Code plugin marketplace — BookBank authoring tools and future tools, one plugin per sibling directory.

plugins.name: bookbank
plugins.description: Skills and tools for authoring BookBank books: research-and-write a topic into a self-contained HTML book, publish to the public library, and turn a GitHub Issue into a generated book.

plugins.name: coursebank
plugins.description: Skills and tools for building CourseBank courses: generate an interactive training course from a source corpus (a repo, docs, or policies) as an installable offline-first PWA with lessons, checkpoints, tracked progress, and a completion certificate. Requires the bookbank plugin for its craft skills.
